about: Accepted accessibility backlog (tools/a11y, docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md). Counts may only go down: fix the problem, then run `npm run a11y -- --update-baseline`. `reasons` says why each accepted warning stays; a reason's key is a finding key or a rule name.

reasons.axe/color-contrast-enhanced: Words on the orange fill (the primary button, a pressed register bit, the map's flag) are above 4.5:1 and below 7:1. Reaching 7:1 needs another orange: a design decision.
reasons.axe/empty-table-header: The empty corner cell of a table (the PIE channel map, the IMU view): an axe best practice. It needs a visually hidden label in src/ui/figures or src/ui/views.
reasons.cvd/confusable-colours: Figures: palette pairs fall together without full colour vision. No mark depends on colour alone.
reasons.layout/height-grows: Figures: the status sentence gets longer once, then the height is held.
reasons.size/drawing-text-narrow: Figures: labels are 9 px at 380 px by design and about 7.3 px at 320 px, because label growth is capped so that labels do not pile up. The Larger view shows them at full size.
reasons.target/size-44: On a touch screen the level dots, the bits of a register, the cells of a waveform and the terminals of a circuit stay under 44 px: twenty dots or sixteen bits in a row have to fit a phone. The arrows beside the dots and the map reach every level.
reasons.target/under-44: Figures: pill buttons and cells are 24 to 43 px. All pass the 24 px rule (2.5.8).
reasons.tokens/contrast-enhanced: The same orange as a token: --accent-ink on --accent is above 4.5:1 and below 7:1. A design decision.
reasons.tokens/cvd-confusable: At 7:1 the state colours are all dark (light theme) or all pale (dark theme), so some pairs fall together without full colour vision. Every use also has a word, an icon or a shape: colour/only-cue checks that.
